calls.video_title: Plug Power Stock Has Taken Investors on a Roller Coaster Ride in 2026
calls.thesis: AVOID, first tracked - not a buying opportunity: revenue recovering ($650M to $768M TTM) and margins improving (op margin -175% to -44.5%, cash-flow-to-sales -150% to -61%), but still deeply loss-making with $838M debt vs $280M cash; 'on the right path, but I need to see more progress before upgrading'.
calls.base_case: Profitable-revenue focus is working; foundation better than ever in a decade of following it.
calls.bull_case: Data-centre energy demand lifts revenue; P/S 1.9 near the low end since 2024.
calls.bear_case: Balance sheet weak; still burning cash; long way to self-sustaining.
